description: This Dart file defines the DocsScreen widget for a Flutter application. It provides a document library user interface with a list of documents, utilizing a provider for state management. It includes UI components such as a custom scroll view, list items, and a floating action button for uploading documents, with snackbar notifications for user feedback.

classes.name: DocsScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of documents with Ocean styling and an upload Floating Action Button.

methods.name: _showSnack
methods.description: A private helper method to show info snackbars with a message.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the DocsScreen, including a list of documents, placeholder when empty, and an upload button.
